title: Tamsin and the Visitor
author: Silas Winterbourne
blurb: Tamsin Kavanagh, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
